symbols.name: selected chunk count
symbols.meaning: The number of address chunks, at most d, on which the layer acts.
symbols.quote: The simultaneous butterfly layer applies $H_0$ coefficientwise to one bit of each of $D\le d$ selected address chunks of $K$ bits, at a common offset, in time $O(Vd^{\lambda'}),$ $\lambda'<1,$ instead of $D$ passes.

symbols.name: phase diagonal
symbols.meaning: The diagonal operator multiplying the value at address x by i to the sum of the D selected bits.
symbols.quote: With $x_1,\dots,x_D$ the selected bits of an address $x,$ this gives $H_0^{\otimes D}=b^D\mathcal S_DC^{\otimes D}\mathcal S_D,$ where the diagonal operator $\mathcal S_D$ acts on an array $z$ by $(\mathcal S_Dz)(x)=i^{x_1+\dots+x_D}z(x).$

symbols.name: array
symbols.meaning: The array of records that the operators act on.
symbols.quote: With $x_1,\dots,x_D$ the selected bits of an address $x,$ this gives $H_0^{\otimes D}=b^D\mathcal S_DC^{\otimes D}\mathcal S_D,$ where the diagonal operator $\mathcal S_D$ acts on an array $z$ by $(\mathcal S_Dz)(x)=i^{x_1+\dots+x_D}z(x).$

symbols.name: group axis count
symbols.meaning: The number of selected axes in a group, e = mf.
symbols.quote: A group of $e=mf$ axes has $m$ slots of $f$ axes; a column holds one bit per slot, in $\mathbb F_2^m.$

symbols.name: slot index
symbols.meaning: The index of a slot and of the residual basis vector placed in it.
symbols.quote: Each edge changes the frame on every column by $\prod_hC_{v_h}^{\eta_h},$ with residual basis vectors $v_h$ indexed by $h,$ $\eta_h=\pm1,$ $C_v=aI+bX_v$ and $X_v$ shifting a column by $v.$

symbols.name: residual vector
symbols.meaning: A residual basis vector of an edge, in F_2^m.
symbols.quote: Each edge changes the frame on every column by $\prod_hC_{v_h}^{\eta_h},$ with residual basis vectors $v_h$ indexed by $h,$ $\eta_h=\pm1,$ $C_v=aI+bX_v$ and $X_v$ shifting a column by $v.$

symbols.name: direction sign
symbols.meaning: The sign +1 or -1 giving the exponent of the kernel for v_h.
symbols.quote: Each edge changes the frame on every column by $\prod_hC_{v_h}^{\eta_h},$ with residual basis vectors $v_h$ indexed by $h,$ $\eta_h=\pm1,$ $C_v=aI+bX_v$ and $X_v$ shifting a column by $v.$

symbols.name: translation kernel
symbols.meaning: The kernel aI + bX_v acting along the direction v.
symbols.quote: Each edge changes the frame on every column by $\prod_hC_{v_h}^{\eta_h},$ with residual basis vectors $v_h$ indexed by $h,$ $\eta_h=\pm1,$ $C_v=aI+bX_v$ and $X_v$ shifting a column by $v.$

symbols.name: column shift
symbols.meaning: The operator shifting a column by v.
symbols.quote: Each edge changes the frame on every column by $\prod_hC_{v_h}^{\eta_h},$ with residual basis vectors $v_h$ indexed by $h,$ $\eta_h=\pm1,$ $C_v=aI+bX_v$ and $X_v$ shifting a column by $v.$

symbols.name: basis-change matrix
symbols.meaning: An invertible F_2 matrix whose first columns are the residual vectors.
symbols.quote: Let $G$ be an invertible $\mathbb F_2$-matrix with first columns $v_h$ and $\mathcal P_G:x\mapsto Gx$ an address permutation.

symbols.name: address permutation
symbols.meaning: The permutation of addresses sending x to Gx.
symbols.quote: Let $G$ be an invertible $\mathbb F_2$-matrix with first columns $v_h$ and $\mathcal P_G:x\mapsto Gx$ an address permutation.

symbols.name: standard basis vector
symbols.meaning: The h-th standard basis vector of F_2^m.
symbols.quote: so the edge change is $\mathcal P_G(\prod_hC_{e_h}^{\eta_h})\mathcal P_G^{-1},$ $e_h$ the $h$-th standard basis vector.

symbols.name: individual chunk count
symbols.meaning: The number of leading chunks handled by individual C kernels.
symbols.quote: So the first $q_0=\lceil\log_2W\rceil\lceil\log_m(2d)\rceil$ chunks get individual $C$ kernels, in $O(V\log d),$ and their bits form a row index of range at least $W^{\lceil\log_md\rceil}.$

symbols.name: chain length bound
symbols.meaning: A(e) bounds the number of arithmetic operations along a chain from an input to an intermediate coefficient.
symbols.quote: Let $A(e)$ bound the operations on a chain from an input to an intermediate coefficient.

symbols.name: per-invocation bound
symbols.meaning: The bound 64(W+m+1)^3 on the operations added by one invocation of the network.
symbols.quote: As $s<Wm,$ the total $24W^3+4s+4W+4$ is below $E=64(W+m+1)^3.$

symbols.name: level factor
symbols.meaning: The number s+E by which each recursion level multiplies the chain bound.
symbols.quote: With $B=s+E,$ $s\varphi+E\le B\varphi$ for any bound $\varphi\ge1,$ so $A(e)\le8dB^{\lceil\log_md\rceil+1}.$

symbols.name: bound
symbols.meaning: A bound at least 1 on a chain length.
symbols.quote: With $B=s+E,$ $s\varphi+E\le B\varphi$ for any bound $\varphi\ge1,$ so $A(e)\le8dB^{\lceil\log_md\rceil+1}.$

symbols.name: exponent of m
symbols.meaning: The least j at least 1 with m^j at least B.
symbols.quote:
With $

u,$ so $A(e)\le8B^2d^{
u+1}.$

symbols.name: guard constant
symbols.meaning: The constant 128 m B^2 in the number of reserved extra bits.

symbols.name: depth
symbols.meaning: The depth of a value, the number of operations in sequence that produced it.
symbols.quote: A depth-$\ell$ value lies in $2^{-(p+\ell)}\mathbb Z[i]$ with modulus at most $2^\ell,$ since addition at most doubles modulus and halving adds a denominator bit.

relations.quote: $C^{\otimes e}$ is computed by the network of [Binary phase frames](phase-frames.md), with $W$ wires and $s$ smaller calls.

Each XORs selected bits of one slot into another; [Packed selected-bit addition](packed-bit-addition.md) XORs selected bits by cyclic shifts of whole chunk ranges plus a repair of exceptional addresses.
The layer is evaluated in [Fixed-point Gaussian dyadic records](fixed-point.md).

derivations.quote: Apply $\mathcal P_G^{-1},$ then $(C^{\eta_h})^{\otimes f}$ to the $f$ bits of slot $h,$ then $\mathcal P_G:$ one child on $f=e/m$ axes per residual vector, exactly $s$ in all. Negative powers add no child: $(C^{-1})^{\otimes f}=(-i)^fZ^{\otimes f}C^{\otimes f}Z^{\otimes f}$ with $Z=\operatorname{diag}(1,-1).$

With $x_1,\dots,x_D$ the selected bits of an address $x,$ this gives $H_0^{\otimes D}=b^D\mathcal S_DC^{\otimes D}\mathcal S_D,$ where the diagonal operator $\mathcal S_D$ acts on an array $z$ by $(\mathcal S_Dz)(x)=i^{x_1+\dots+x_D}z(x).$
Their number is fixed, so the basis change and its inverse on $e$ axis chunks cost $O(V((eK)^\tau+1))$

Zero rows pad each block to a multiple of that, making the row count at depth $j$ divisible by $W^{\lceil\log_md\rceil-j};$ fewer rows are added than the block holds, so the volume at most doubles. With $\beta=\tfrac12$ and $F(e)$ the time divided by volume,
$$F(e)\le \tfrac sW F(e/m)+O((eK)^\tau+1)\ (e\ge d^\beta),\qquad F(e)=O(e)\ (e<d^\beta),$$
the recursion of [Recursive power saving](rank-recurrence.md). As $s/W\le m^\sigma,$ $\sigma<1,$ internal levels sum geometrically, leaves add $O(e^\sigma d^{\beta(1-\sigma)}),$ and $\log d$ pieces give $O(d^{\lambda'}).$
